# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `xmake docs-config` from src/settings/BuiltinSchema.cpp. Do not edit by hand. -->

The configuration file is `~/.config/noctara/config.toml` (XDG_CONFIG_HOME is honoured). A documented template is written on first run, and edits are applied live.

Precedence, lowest first: built-in defaults, system config (`/etc/xdg/noctara/config.toml`), user config, `NOCTARA_*` environment variables, command-line flags (`--set key=value` or the listed aliases). Settings marked *restart* take effect on the next launch.

Secrets such as OAuth tokens and proxy credentials are never read from or written to this file; they live in the system secret store.

## General

### `[general]` Language

Interface language.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `language` | enum | `"system"` | `system`, `en`, `ru` | **Language.** Applied immediately, without a restart. (env `NOCTARA_GENERAL_LANGUAGE`, CLI `--lang=`) |

### `[general.formatting]` Formatting

How times and numbers are displayed.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `time_format` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `12h`, `24h` | **Time format.** Clock style for dates and times. (env `NOCTARA_GENERAL_FORMATTING_TIME_FORMAT`) |
| `compact_numbers` | bool | `true` | — | **Compact numbers.** Show large counts as 1.2K instead of 1,234. (env `NOCTARA_GENERAL_FORMATTING_COMPACT_NUMBERS`) |

## Appearance

### `[appearance.theme]` Theme

Midnight (dark), Frost (light) or follow the system.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | enum | `"system"` | `system`, `dark`, `light` | **Theme.** System follows the desktop color scheme live. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_THEME_MODE`, CLI `--theme=`) |
| `custom` | string | `""` | — | **Custom theme.** A theme file from the themes folder that overrides colors, shapes, fonts or motion. Themes are data only and are reloaded when they change. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_THEME_CUSTOM`) |
| `enforce_contrast` | bool | `true` | — | **Enforce readable contrast.** Adjust colors that would fall below WCAG AA contrast against glass. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_THEME_ENFORCE_CONTRAST`) |

### `[appearance.accent]` Accent color

The whole palette is generated from a single accent color.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `adaptive` | bool | `true` | — | **Adapt accent colors to cover art.** Derive the accent palette from the current track's artwork. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_ACCENT_ADAPTIVE`) |
| `color` | color | `"#6774f9"` | — | **Accent color.** Seed color for the whole palette when adaptive accents are off. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_ACCENT_COLOR`) |
| `extraction` | enum | `"vivid"` | `vivid`, `balanced`, `soft` | **Palette extraction.** How saturated the colours taken from the artwork are. Recomputed on every track. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_ACCENT_EXTRACTION`) |

### `[appearance.backdrop]` Backdrop

The light behind the interface.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | enum | `"aurora"` | `aurora`, `cover`, `dark` | **Backdrop style.** Aurora: soft light in the palette colours. Cover art: the blurred artwork. Dark: nearly plain. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_BACKDROP_STYLE`) |
| `animate` | bool | `true` | — | **Animate backdrop.** Slow drifting motion. Paused automatically when the window is hidden. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_BACKDROP_ANIMATE`) |

### `[appearance.glow]` Glow

Soft accent-coloured light around artwork, controls and progress.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `intensity` | number | `0.3` | 0 … 1 | **Glow intensity.** Strength of the glow and of the backdrop light. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLOW_INTENSITY`) |
| `cover` | bool | `true` | — | **Artwork glow.** A shadow in the artwork's colour under covers. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLOW_COVER`) |
| `controls` | bool | `true` | — | **Button and selection glow.** A soft halo around accented buttons and active items. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLOW_CONTROLS`) |
| `progress` | bool | `true` | — | **Progress glow.** Lights up the played part of the progress bar and waveform. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLOW_PROGRESS`) |

### `[appearance.glass]` Glass

How translucent surfaces are rendered.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | enum | `"kawase"` | `kawase`, `gaussian`, `solid` | **Backdrop blur.** How the backdrop behind surfaces is blurred. Blurs need hardware acceleration; None is the cheapest. Works with every surface style. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLASS_STYLE`) |
| `surface` | enum | `"frosted"` | `frosted`, `liquid`, `flat` | **Surface style.** Frosted: lit edges, sheen and depth. Liquid Glass: refractive edges (needs a blur). Flat: the blurred backdrop and a tint, without highlights or shadows. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLASS_SURFACE`) |
| `blur_strength` | number | `0.6` | 0 … 1 | **Blur strength.** How strongly the backdrop is blurred. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLASS_BLUR_STRENGTH`) |
| `opacity` | number | `0.0` | 0 … 1 | **Glass tint.** Opacity of the tint applied to glass surfaces. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLASS_OPACITY`) |
| `grain` | number | `0.0` | 0 … 1 | **Grain.** Fine noise that prevents banding in gradients. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLASS_GRAIN`) |
| `quality` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `low`, `medium`, `high` | **Effects quality.** Auto lowers quality when frames take too long and raises it again later. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLASS_QUALITY`) |
| `buttons` | enum | `"frosted"` | `frosted`, `liquid`, `tinted`, `plain`, `clear`, `solid` | **Button material.** Frosted: milky blurred glass. Liquid: glossy glass with a bright rim. Tinted: glass coloured by the accent. Plain: a flat translucent fill. Clear: outline only. Solid: opaque. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLASS_BUTTONS`) |
| `primary_buttons` | enum | `"filled"` | `filled`, `material`, `outline`, `gradient` | **Main buttons.** Play and other main actions. Filled: a flat accent shape. Like other buttons: the button material with an accent icon. Outline: an accent ring. Gradient: glossy accent glass. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLASS_PRIMARY_BUTTONS`) |
| `reduce_transparency` | bool | `false` | — | **Reduce transparency.** Use opaque surfaces everywhere. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_GLASS_REDUCE_TRANSPARENCY`) |

### `[appearance.motion]` Motion

Animations and transitions.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `reduce` | bool | `false` | — | **Reduce motion.** Replace movement with simple fades and stop the drifting backdrop. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_MOTION_REDUCE`) |
| `speed` | number | `1.0` | 0 … 3 | **Animation speed.** Duration multiplier. 0 turns animations off. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_MOTION_SPEED`) |
| `color_transition` | enum | `"smooth"` | `fast`, `smooth`, `slow` | **Colour transitions.** How quickly colours blend into the new palette when the track or theme changes. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_MOTION_COLOR_TRANSITION`) |

### `[appearance.shape]` Shape

Corner rounding of surfaces and artwork.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `corner_radius` | enum | `"default"` | `sharp`, `default`, `round`, `custom` | **Corner radius.** Rounding of panels, cards and buttons. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_SHAPE_CORNER_RADIUS`) |
| `corner_radius_multiplier` | number | `1.0` | 0 … 2 | **Corner radius multiplier.** Scales every corner radius. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_SHAPE_CORNER_RADIUS_MULTIPLIER`) |
| `buttons` | enum | `"pill"` | `pill`, `soft`, `sharp` | **Button shape.** Corner style of buttons and segmented controls. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_SHAPE_BUTTONS`) |
| `cover_art` | enum | `"rounded"` | `rounded`, `square`, `circle` | **Cover art shape.** Shape of artwork in lists and the player. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_SHAPE_COVER_ART`) |

### `[appearance.text]` Text and scale

Interface zoom and fonts. Missing fonts fall back to the bundled ones.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ui_scale` | integer | `100` | 75 … 200 | **Interface zoom.** Scales the whole interface. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_TEXT_UI_SCALE`) |
| `font_scale` | integer | `100` | 80 … 150 | **Text size.** Scales text relative to the interface zoom. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_TEXT_FONT_SCALE`) |
| `heading_font` | string | `""` | — | **Heading font.** Font family for titles. Empty uses Manrope. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_TEXT_HEADING_FONT`) |
| `body_font` | string | `""` | — | **Body font.** Font family for interface text. Empty uses Inter. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_TEXT_BODY_FONT`) |
| `mono_font` | string | `""` | — | **Monospace font.** Font family for timings and technical details. Empty uses JetBrains Mono. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_TEXT_MONO_FONT`) |

### `[appearance.icons]` Icons

Icon appearance.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `weight` | enum | `"regular"` | `light`, `regular`, `bold` | **Icon weight.** Stroke thickness of icons. (env `NOCTARA_APPEARANCE_ICONS_WEIGHT`) |

## Layout

### `[layout.content]` Content

How densely pages are laid out.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `density` | enum | `"cozy"` | `compact`, `cozy`, `airy` | **Density.** Spacing between sections, cards and rows. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_CONTENT_DENSITY`) |

### `[layout.navigation]` Navigation

Where the navigation sits and what it shows.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `position` | enum | `"left"` | `left`, `right`, `bottom` | **Position.** Which edge of the window the navigation sits on. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_NAVIGATION_POSITION`) |
| `mode` | enum | `"compact"` | `compact`, `expanded`, `auto_hide` | **Style.** Auto-hide shows the navigation when the pointer reaches its edge. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_NAVIGATION_MODE`) |
| `items` | string list | `["home", "search", "library", "likes", "history", "charts", "downloads"]` | — | **Pages in the navigation.** Their order and which are shown. Settings is always there. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_NAVIGATION_ITEMS`) |

### `[layout.player]` Player bar

The bar with the current track.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `position` | enum | `"bottom"` | `bottom`, `top` | **Position.** Where the player bar floats. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_PLAYER_POSITION`) |
| `size` | enum | `"regular"` | `compact`, `regular`, `large` | **Size.** Height of the player bar and its cover. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_PLAYER_SIZE`) |
| `waveform` | bool | `true` | — | **Waveform.** Off shows a plain progress line instead. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_PLAYER_WAVEFORM`) |
| `time` | bool | `true` | — | **Elapsed and total time.** Times on both sides of the waveform. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_PLAYER_TIME`) |
| `volume` | bool | `true` | — | **Volume.** The volume slider (narrow windows show only the mute button). (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_PLAYER_VOLUME`) |
| `queue_button` | bool | `true` | — | **Queue button.** The queue also opens with its shortcut. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_PLAYER_QUEUE_BUTTON`) |

### `[layout.views]` Pages

How each page shows its items.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `library` | enum | `"grid"` | `list`, `grid` | **Library.** How the page shows its items at first; the page's own switch changes it too. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_VIEWS_LIBRARY`) |
| `likes` | enum | `"list"` | `list`, `grid` | **Likes.** How the page shows its items at first; the page's own switch changes it too. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_VIEWS_LIKES`) |
| `history` | enum | `"list"` | `list`, `grid` | **History.** How the page shows its items at first; the page's own switch changes it too. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_VIEWS_HISTORY`) |
| `charts` | enum | `"list"` | `list`, `grid` | **Charts.** How the page shows its items at first; the page's own switch changes it too. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_VIEWS_CHARTS`) |
| `card_size` | enum | `"medium"` | `small`, `medium`, `large` | **Card size.** Grids fit as many cards of this size per row as the window allows. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_VIEWS_CARD_SIZE`) |

### `[layout.rows]` Track rows

What a track row shows besides the title and artist.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `plays` | bool | `true` | — | **Plays.** How often a track was played. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_ROWS_PLAYS`) |
| `likes` | bool | `false` | — | **Likes.** How many people liked a track. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_ROWS_LIKES`) |
| `reposts` | bool | `false` | — | **Reposts.** How often a track was reposted. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_ROWS_REPOSTS`) |
| `duration` | bool | `true` | — | **Duration.** The length of a track or playlist. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_ROWS_DURATION`) |

### `[layout.full_player]` Full-screen player

The large player with the cover art.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `art_size` | enum | `"large"` | `medium`, `large` | **Cover size.** How much of the player the cover art takes. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_FULL_PLAYER_ART_SIZE`) |
| `queue` | bool | `true` | — | **Queue beside the cover.** When the window is wide enough. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_FULL_PLAYER_QUEUE`) |
| `waveform` | bool | `true` | — | **Waveform.** Off shows a plain progress line instead. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_FULL_PLAYER_WAVEFORM`) |

### `[layout.window]` Window

The window frame, size and what happens at start and close.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `decorations` | enum | `"native"` | `native`, `custom` | **Window frame.** Noctara draws its own title bar and buttons in the glass style. Window managers without decorations keep showing none. (*restart*, env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_WINDOW_DECORATIONS`) |
| `remember_geometry` | bool | `true` | — | **Remember window size.** Open with the size (and, where the system allows, the position) of last time. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_WINDOW_REMEMBER_GEOMETRY`) |
| `start_page` | enum | `"home"` | `home`, `search`, `library`, `likes`, `history`, `charts`, `downloads`, `last` | **Start page.** The page shown when Noctara opens. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_WINDOW_START_PAGE`) |
| `start_minimized` | bool | `false` | — | **Start minimized.** Start in the tray when there is one, otherwise minimized. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_WINDOW_START_MINIMIZED`) |
| `close_to_tray` | bool | `true` | — | **Hide to the tray when closed.** Closing the window hides it in the tray and playback goes on; Quit in the tray menu ends Noctara. Off: closing the window quits. Needs the tray icon. (env `NOCTARA_LAYOUT_WINDOW_CLOSE_TO_TRAY`) |

## Playback

### `[playback.stream]` Sound

Which of SoundCloud's streams is played.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `quality` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `best`, `data_saver` | **Audio quality.** Auto plays the best stream your account may play, and the smallest one on a metered connection. Applies from the next track. (env `NOCTARA_PLAYBACK_STREAM_QUALITY`) |

### `[playback.transitions]` Transitions

How one track leads into the next.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `crossfade` | integer | `0` | 0 … 12 | **Crossfade.** Blends the end of a track into the next one. 0 plays them back to back without a gap. (env `NOCTARA_PLAYBACK_TRANSITIONS_CROSSFADE`) |

### `[playback.volume]` Volume

Volume when Noctara starts.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `remember` | bool | `true` | — | **Remember volume.** Start with the volume you last used. (env `NOCTARA_PLAYBACK_VOLUME_REMEMBER`) |
| `startup` | integer | `70` | 0 … 100 | **Volume at start.** The volume every session starts with. (env `NOCTARA_PLAYBACK_VOLUME_STARTUP`) |

### `[playback.queue]` Queue

What happens when the queue runs out.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `autoplay` | bool | `true` | — | **Autoplay related tracks.** When the queue ends, keep playing tracks related to the last one. Repeat takes precedence. (env `NOCTARA_PLAYBACK_QUEUE_AUTOPLAY`) |
| `restore` | bool | `true` | — | **Restore the queue.** Open with the queue, track and position of last time, paused. (env `NOCTARA_PLAYBACK_QUEUE_RESTORE`) |

### `[playback.desktop]` Desktop integration

Controlling playback from outside the window.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `media_controls` | bool | `true` | — | **Media keys and system controls.** Lets media keys, the desktop's media controls and other apps control playback and show the current track (MPRIS). (env `NOCTARA_PLAYBACK_DESKTOP_MEDIA_CONTROLS`) |
| `pause_for_others` | bool | `false` | — | **Pause when another player starts.** Pauses Noctara when another app starts playing and tells the desktop about it (MPRIS), such as a video in the browser. (env `NOCTARA_PLAYBACK_DESKTOP_PAUSE_FOR_OTHERS`) |
| `tray` | bool | `true` | — | **Tray icon.** Playback controls in the system tray, where the desktop provides one. (env `NOCTARA_PLAYBACK_DESKTOP_TRAY`) |
| `notifications` | bool | `false` | — | **Notify on track change.** Shows a desktop notification with the next track while Noctara's window is not in front. (env `NOCTARA_PLAYBACK_DESKTOP_NOTIFICATIONS`) |

### `[playback.protected]` Protected tracks

Tracks SoundCloud streams only encrypted (DRM). They play in a small background player with Widevine and are never stored on this computer.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | bool | `true` | — | **Play protected tracks.** Plays encrypted tracks through the protected player, which starts only when one plays. Off skips them. (env `NOCTARA_PLAYBACK_PROTECTED_ENABLED`) |
| `auto_install` | bool | `true` | — | **Set up the protected player automatically.** Downloads it once (castlabs Electron with Widevine, about 125 MB) when it is missing, in the background and not on a metered connection. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_PLAYBACK_PROTECTED_AUTO_INSTALL`) |
| `helper` | path | `""` | — | **Protected player folder.** Folder with a protected player of your own (as made by `xmake drm-helper`). Empty uses one next to Noctara, in its install directory, or the one Noctara set up. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_PLAYBACK_PROTECTED_HELPER`) |
| `idle_shutdown` | integer | `5` | 1 … 60 | **Close the protected player after.** Frees its memory when no protected track has played for this long. A paused track resumes where it was. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_PLAYBACK_PROTECTED_IDLE_SHUTDOWN`) |
| `gpu` | bool | `false` | — | **Protected player uses the GPU.** It only plays audio and never needs the GPU. Applies when it next starts. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_PLAYBACK_PROTECTED_GPU`) |

## Library & Content

### `[library.loading]` Loading

How lists of tracks, playlists and people are fetched from SoundCloud.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `page_size` | integer | `50` | 10 … 200 | **Items per request.** Lists load more as you scroll. Larger requests mean fewer pauses but more data up front. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_LIBRARY_LOADING_PAGE_SIZE`) |

| `next` | shortcut | `"Ctrl+Right"` | — | **Next track.**  (env `NOCTARA_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUTS_NEXT`) |

| `seek_forward` | shortcut | `"Shift+Right"` | — | **Forward 5 seconds.**  (env `NOCTARA_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUTS_SEEK_FORWARD`) |
| `seek_backward` | shortcut | `"Shift+Left"` | — | **Back 5 seconds.**  (env `NOCTARA_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUTS_SEEK_BACKWARD`) |
| `volume_up` | shortcut | `"Ctrl+Up"` | — | **Volume up.**  (env `NOCTARA_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUTS_VOLUME_UP`) |
| `volume_down` | shortcut | `"Ctrl+Down"` | — | **Volume down.**  (env `NOCTARA_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUTS_VOLUME_DOWN`) |
| `mute` | shortcut | `"Ctrl+M"` | — | **Mute.**  (env `NOCTARA_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUTS_MUTE`) |
| `shuffle` | shortcut | `"Ctrl+S"` | — | **Shuffle.**  (env `NOCTARA_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUTS_SHUFFLE`) |
| `repeat` | shortcut | `"Ctrl+R"` | — | **Repeat.**  (env `NOCTARA_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUTS_REPEAT`) |
| `queue` | shortcut | `"Ctrl+Shift+Q"` | — | **Show the queue.**  (env `NOCTARA_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUTS_QUEUE`) |
| `full_player` | shortcut | `"Ctrl+Shift+F"` | — | **Full-screen player.**  (env `NOCTARA_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUTS_FULL_PLAYER`) |
| `search` | shortcut | `"Ctrl+K"` | — | **Search.**  (env `NOCTARA_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUTS_SEARCH`) |
| `back` | shortcut | `"Alt+Left"` | — | **Back.**  (env `NOCTARA_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUTS_BACK`) |
| `settings` | shortcut | `"Ctrl+,"` | — | **Settings.**  (env `NOCTARA_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUTS_SETTINGS`) |

### `[keyboard.global]` Global shortcuts

Shortcuts that work while Noctara is in the background.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | bool | `false` | — | **Global playback shortcuts.** Registers play/pause, next, previous and “show Noctara” with the desktop (XDG global shortcuts portal), which asks you for the keys. Media keys work without this. (env `NOCTARA_KEYBOARD_GLOBAL_ENABLED`) |

## Performance

### `[performance.gpu]` Graphics

GPU acceleration. Changes take effect after a restart.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `acceleration` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `on`, `off` | **Hardware acceleration.** Auto uses the GPU unless it is missing, a software rasterizer or known to be unreliable. Off renders on the CPU and disables blur effects. (*restart*, env `NOCTARA_PERFORMANCE_GPU_ACCELERATION`, CLI `--gpu=`) |
| `api` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `vulkan`, `opengl` | **Graphics API.** Rendering backend used for hardware acceleration. (*restart*, env `NOCTARA_PERFORMANCE_GPU_API`, CLI `--graphics-api=`) |
| `preference` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `integrated`, `discrete` | **GPU preference.** Which GPU to use on systems with more than one. (*restart*, *advanced*, env `NOCTARA_PERFORMANCE_GPU_PREFERENCE`) |

### `[performance.rendering]` Rendering

Frame pacing.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vsync` | bool | `true` | — | **Vertical sync.** Synchronise frames with the display to avoid tearing. (*restart*, *advanced*, env `NOCTARA_PERFORMANCE_RENDERING_VSYNC`) |
| `frame_rate_cap` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `30`, `60`, `120`, `144`, `unlimited` | **Frame rate limit.** Upper bound for animation frame rate. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_PERFORMANCE_RENDERING_FRAME_RATE_CAP`) |

### `[performance.power]` Power

How Noctara reduces its own energy use. Your system power profile is not changed.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `energy_saving` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `always`, `off` | **Energy saving.** While active, Noctara pauses the animated backdrop, uses the lighter Dual Kawase blur instead of Liquid Glass or Gaussian, and limits animations that play by themselves to 30 frames per second; scrolling and clicks stay at full speed. Automatic turns it on only while the computer runs on battery. (env `NOCTARA_PERFORMANCE_POWER_ENERGY_SAVING`) |

## Network

### `[network.usage]` Data usage

When and how much Noctara downloads.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `offline` | bool | `false` | — | **Offline mode.** Make no network connections at all. Only content that is already cached is available. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_USAGE_OFFLINE`, CLI `--offline=`) |
| `metered` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `on`, `off` | **Metered connection.** On a metered connection Noctara skips prefetching and other background downloads. Auto follows the system's setting for the current network. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_USAGE_METERED`) |
| `bandwidth_limit` | integer | `0` | 0 … 1000 | **Download speed limit.** Upper bound for all downloads together. 0 means no limit. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_USAGE_BANDWIDTH_LIMIT`) |

### `[network.dns]` DNS

How server names are turned into addresses. Applies to all of Noctara's connections without a restart.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | enum | `"system"` | `system`, `custom`, `doh` | **DNS mode.** System uses your computer's settings. DNS over HTTPS encrypts lookups so the network cannot see or change them. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_MODE`, CLI `--dns=`) |
| `server_preset` | enum | `"cloudflare"` | `cloudflare`, `google`, `quad9`, `adguard`, `custom` | **DNS servers.** Asked in order; the next one is tried when a server does not answer. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_SERVER_PRESET`) |
| `servers` | string list | `[]` | — | **Server addresses.** IPv4 or IPv6 addresses, optionally with a port: 192.0.2.1, [2001:db8::1]:5353. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_SERVERS`) |
| `doh_provider` | enum | `"cloudflare"` | `cloudflare`, `google`, `quad9`, `adguard`, `mullvad`, `custom` | **DNS-over-HTTPS provider.** Custom accepts any RFC 8484 server, for example a personal NextDNS address. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_DOH_PROVIDER`) |
| `doh_url` | url | `""` | — | **DoH address.** For example https://dns.example/dns-query. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_DOH_URL`) |
| `doh_bootstrap` | string list | `[]` | — | **Bootstrap addresses.** IP addresses of the DoH server, so its own name never has to be looked up elsewhere. Required when fallback to the system resolver is off. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_DOH_BOOTSTRAP`) |
| `doh_allow_insecure` | bool | `false` | — | **Allow insecure DoH.** Accept a plain http:// address, but only for a server on this computer or the local network. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_DOH_ALLOW_INSECURE`) |
| `fallback_to_system` | bool | `true` | — | **Fall back to the system resolver.** Keeps Noctara working when the chosen servers are unreachable, but those lookups are then visible to your network. Off is strict mode: lookups fail instead. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_FALLBACK_TO_SYSTEM`) |
| `ip_family` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `prefer_ipv4`, `prefer_ipv6`, `ipv4`, `ipv6` | **IP version.** Auto tries IPv6 and IPv4 in parallel and keeps whichever connects first. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_IP_FAMILY`) |
| `host_overrides` | string list | `[]` | — | **Host overrides.** Fixed addresses that skip DNS, as host=address. Repeat a host to give it several addresses. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_HOST_OVERRIDES`) |

### `[network.dns.cache]` DNS cache

How long answers are remembered. Lifetimes from the DNS server are kept within these bounds.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `min_ttl` | integer | `60` | 0 … 3600 | **Minimum lifetime.** Answers are kept at least this long. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_CACHE_MIN_TTL`) |
| `max_ttl` | integer | `3600` | 60 … 86400 | **Maximum lifetime.** Answers are looked up again after this long. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_CACHE_MAX_TTL`) |
| `negative_ttl` | integer | `30` | 0 … 3600 | **Failed lookups.** How long a name that does not exist is remembered as missing. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_DNS_CACHE_NEGATIVE_TTL`) |

### `[network.proxy]` Proxy

Route Noctara's traffic through a proxy server.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | enum | `"system"` | `none`, `system`, `manual` | **Proxy mode.** System uses the proxy variables of the environment (http_proxy, no_proxy …) or, if none are set, your desktop's proxy settings. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_PROXY_MODE`, CLI `--proxy-mode=`) |
| `type` | enum | `"http"` | `http`, `https`, `socks4`, `socks5`, `socks5h` | **Proxy type.** HTTP also carries HTTPS sites, and suits most proxies, including those listed as HTTP(S). HTTPS encrypts the connection to the proxy itself and works only if the proxy supports it. With SOCKS4 and SOCKS5 Noctara looks up server names itself; the others let the proxy do it. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_PROXY_TYPE`) |
| `host` | string | `""` | — | **Proxy host.** Host name or IP address of the proxy server. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_PROXY_HOST`) |
| `port` | integer | `8080` | 1 … 65535 | **Proxy port.** Username and password, if the proxy needs them, are kept in the system keyring, never in the configuration file. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_PROXY_PORT`) |
| `bypass` | string list | `[]` | — | **Connect directly to.** Hosts that bypass the proxy: example.com (with its subdomains), *.example.com, IP addresses or ranges such as 10.0.0.0/8. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_PROXY_BYPASS`) |
| `bypass_local` | bool | `true` | — | **Bypass for local addresses.** Connect directly to localhost, private networks and names without a dot. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_PROXY_BYPASS_LOCAL`) |

### `[network.connection]` Connections

Protocol, time limits and retries.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `http_version` | enum | `"auto"` | `auto`, `1.1`, `2`, `3` | **HTTP version.** Auto uses HTTP/2 where the server supports it. HTTP/3 falls back to older versions when it is blocked. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_CONNECTION_HTTP_VERSION`) |
| `connect_timeout` | integer | `15` | 1 … 120 | **Connection timeout.** How long to wait for a server, including the proxy and the encrypted handshake. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_CONNECTION_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`) |
| `read_timeout` | integer | `30` | 5 … 300 | **Stall timeout.** A download is aborted (and retried) when no data arrives for this long. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_CONNECTION_READ_TIMEOUT`) |
| `retries` | integer | `2` | 0 … 10 | **Retries.** How often a failed request is repeated. Only requests that are safe to repeat are retried. (env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_CONNECTION_RETRIES`) |
| `retry_backoff` | integer | `500` | 100 … 10000 | **Retry delay.** Wait before the first retry; it doubles with every further attempt. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_CONNECTION_RETRY_BACKOFF`) |
| `max_connections` | integer | `16` | 1 … 64 | **Maximum connections.** Open connections in total. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_CONNECTION_MAX_CONNECTIONS`) |
| `max_per_host` | integer | `6` | 1 … 32 | **Connections per server.** Open connections to one server. HTTP/2 carries many requests over one. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_CONNECTION_MAX_PER_HOST`) |

### `[network.tls]` Security

Encrypted connections. Certificates are always verified.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `min_version` | enum | `"1.2"` | `1.2`, `1.3` | **Minimum TLS version.** Older protocol versions are never used. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_TLS_MIN_VERSION`) |
| `ca_bundle` | path | `""` | — | **CA bundle.** PEM file with the certificate authorities to trust instead of the system's, for networks that inspect encrypted traffic. Empty uses the system store. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_NETWORK_TLS_CA_BUNDLE`) |

## Storage & Cache

### `[cache]` Audio cache

Tracks you play are kept on this computer, so replays, seeking and the next track start instantly and use no data. Protected tracks are never stored.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `audio_enabled` | bool | `true` | — | **Keep played tracks.** Off keeps only the current track in memory; nothing is written to disk. (env `NOCTARA_CACHE_AUDIO_ENABLED`, CLI `--audio-cache=`) |
| `disk_mb` | integer | `2048` | 0 … 102400 | **Disk space for tracks.** The tracks played longest ago make room for new ones. 0 turns the disk cache off. (env `NOCTARA_CACHE_DISK_MB`) |
| `ram_mb` | integer | `32` | 16 … 2048 | **Memory for tracks.** For the current and upcoming tracks, so seeking is instant. Released early when the system runs low on memory. (env `NOCTARA_CACHE_RAM_MB`) |
| `prefetch` | integer | `2` | 0 … 5 | **Prepare upcoming tracks.** How many tracks of the queue are downloaded in advance. None on a metered connection; at most one while the disk cache is off. (env `NOCTARA_CACHE_PREFETCH`) |
| `embed_tags` | bool | `true` | — | **Embed tags in cached audio.** Completed tracks get title, artist and cover inside the file. The audio itself is never altered. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_CACHE_EMBED_TAGS`) |
| `dir` | path | `""` | — | **Cache location.** A folder for all caches; Noctara creates a “noctara” folder inside it. Empty uses the standard cache folder of your system. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_CACHE_DIR`) |
| `clear_on_exit` | bool | `false` | — | **Clear cache on exit.** Removes cached tracks, images and metadata whenever Noctara quits. (env `NOCTARA_CACHE_CLEAR_ON_EXIT`) |
| `min_free_mb` | integer | `1024` | 0 … 102400 | **Keep free on disk.** The cache gives space back before the disk gets fuller than this. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_CACHE_MIN_FREE_MB`) |

### `[cache.images]` Images

Cover art and profile pictures.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ram_mb` | integer | `32` | 16 … 1024 | **Memory for images.** Decoded images ready to be shown. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_CACHE_IMAGES_RAM_MB`) |
| `disk_mb` | integer | `512` | 0 … 10240 | **Disk space for images.** 0 keeps images in memory only. (env `NOCTARA_CACHE_IMAGES_DISK_MB`) |

### `[cache.metadata]` Metadata

Track, playlist and profile information from SoundCloud, so pages open quickly and work offline.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `disk_mb` | integer | `128` | 0 … 2048 | **Disk space for metadata.** 0 turns the metadata cache off; pages then always load from the network. (*advanced*, env `NOCTARA_CACHE_METADATA_DISK_MB`) |

## Advanced

### `[soundcloud]` SoundCloud

How Noctara talks to SoundCloud's web API.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `client_id` | string | `""` | — | **Client ID.** Empty: found automatically in SoundCloud's web player. Set it only if that stops working; it is not a secret and not tied to your account. (env `NOCTARA_SOUNDCLOUD_CLIENT_ID`) |
